correctness.rationale: PASS. Every cyclic k-spectrum determines lower spectra, the numbers of zero/one symbols and the t occurrences each of 01 and 10. Presence of short factors y x^s y pins all runs shorter than k-1 to the source length, whereas x^{k-1} enforces long-run lower bounds. With fixed totals, mixed k-windows cannot see redistributions of excess above k-1 and the monochromatic windows have fixed counts. Allowed ordered run-pair vectors are therefore weak compositions with totals t max(a-k+1,0) and t max(b-k+1,0); Burnside over simultaneous cyclic shifts gives the stated totient/binomial formula. Nonuniform vs constant excess vectors show k_unique=1+max(a,b). Independent exhaustive partitions of all binary necklaces up through n=12 for every k and valid a,b,t agreed with formula; this is corroboration, the all-n proof is by run structure and Burnside.
